m-seq.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  title Greeting
  participant A as Alice
  actor B as Bob
  participant C
  A->>B: Hello
  loop Every minute
    B-->>A: Fine
  end
  alt sick
    opt really
      B-)A: cough
    end
  else well
    B->>C: great
  end
  C->>C: self

p-seq.text:
@startuml
actor User
participant "Web App" as W
participant Server as S
database DB
User -> W : open
activate W
W ->> S : fetch
S --> W : data
alt cache hit
  S -> S : read cache
else miss
  S -> DB : query
  DB --> S : rows
end
create participant Log
S -> Log : new
note over W, S : all HTTPS
note right of User
  happy
  path
end note
@enduml

p-usecase.text:
@startuml
left to right direction
actor Customer
actor "Shop Admin" as Admin
rectangle Shop {
  usecase "Browse catalogue" as UC1
  usecase (Checkout) as UC2
  (Pay)
}
Customer --> UC1
Customer --> UC2
UC2 ..> (Pay) : <<include>>
Admin -- UC1
Admin --|> Customer
@enduml

p-legacy.text:
